original_evidence: Stop gathering when any of these holds:
the remaining candidates all call for the same bounded change
the remaining available checks do not discriminate among the retained candidates
all but one or two candidates have been contradicted by at least two sources that do not share an origin
If none holds, keep several candidates open and continue.
neutral_evidence: Stop gathering evidence for a handoff when any one of these conditions holds:
all remaining candidates call for the same bounded change
the remaining available checks do not distinguish among retained candidates
all but one or two candidates have been contradicted by at least two sources that do not share an origin
If none holds, keep several candidates open and continue.
stopping_condition_preserved.rationale: All three alternative stopping conditions retain their per-handoff scope, thresholds and source-independence requirement. Continued inquiry and the prohibition on asserting a single cause merely to close analysis are preserved.

original_evidence: Pilot one bounded change matched to the leading candidate at a handoff.
Declare the expected response in advance and compare turnaround under comparable demand and staffing.
If the expected response does not appear, reopen the differential for that handoff instead of escalating the same change.
neutral_evidence: Pilot one bounded change matched to the leading candidate at a handoff.
Declare the expected response before the pilot and compare turnaround under comparable demand and staffing.

next_inquiry_preserved.rationale: Preserves the bounded pilot, all example interventions, advance prediction, comparable conditions, and conditional reopening rather than escalation. Adjacent-handoff monitoring and generalisation checks are also retained.
